address: Hôtel Bleu, 1 boulevard des Moulins, Carry-le-Rouet, 13620, France
bio: Located within a hotel overlooking the port of Carry-le-Rouet, this fine dining restaurant boasts stunning panoramic views of the sea and the Frioul archipelago. Beyond a gorgeous enamelled lava stone bar, diners drop anchor in a space done out in a maritime decor (shades of white and blue) with marble flooring. Chef Ilane Tinchant has a proven track record, having previously worked at Villa Madie and Sylvestre Wahid. The kitchen lovingly showcases the Mediterranean: first with seasonal produce, local bread and olive oil from Les Baux-de-Provence, but above all with a seafood-oriented menu featuring all manner of marine life.
